htn_kidney.title: Nanoplastics Exacerbated Renal Injury amid Hypertension: Rethinking Health Hazards in Disease and Implication of Renal Senescence and EMT Associated with Sirt1 Downregulation.
htn_kidney.authors: Liu Y, Ji D, Lin Y
htn_kidney.zhSummary: 该文聚焦高血压肾病，属于临床研究。核心观点：高血压肾病是一种慢性疾病，对已有高血压人群构成显着的健康风险。 临床提示：纳米塑料可能会对包括肾脏在内的多个器官造成潜在伤害。
htn_kidney.abstract: Hypertensive nephropathy is a chronic disease posing a remarkable health risk to the pre-existing hypertensive population. Nanoplastics could elicit potential harm to multiple organs, including the kidneys. To identify the hazards of aged polystyrene nanoplastics (aPS-NPs) in the context of hypertension and investigate the underlying toxicological mechanisms, spontaneously hypertensive rats (SHRs) were treated with aPS-NPs (75 mg/kg/day) by gavage for 35 days. We observed exacerbated renal injury with increased collagen deposition and elevated expression of fibrosis-related proteins (FN, COL1A1, and α-SMA) in SHRs exposed to aPS-NPs. portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：经颈静脉肝内门体分流术（TIPS）用于治疗失代偿性肝硬化患者的门脉高压并发症。 临床提示：然而，其对移植候选资格和围手术期结果的影响仍不清楚。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Transjugular intrahepatic portosystemic shunt (TIPS) is utilized to manage portal hypertensive complications in patients with decompensated cirrhosis. However, its effects on transplant candidacy and peri-operative outcomes remain unclear. We hence aimed to evaluate peri-transplant outcomes and implications of TIPS in liver transplant (LT) candidates. We conducted a retrospective cohort study of adult LT candidates listed in the United Network for Organ Sharing (UNOS) database from January 1, 2000 to January 3, 2025.
